title: LED Altar Studies
description: Five independent studies orbiting the LED-backed stained-glass altar theme, each focusing on one material or structural detail.
creative_direction: Five standalone close-ups: a single glass cell with LED pixel backing, the copper circuit frame, a donor-panel data readout, a candelabrum as an LED forest, and a rear diagnostic view of the altar. No reference dependency.
